provenance.source: Two diagonal searches and a fixed-K/g sweep of LIBERO libero_10 on one AutoDL host, built with the record command from their outputs. See issue #87 of MINT-SJTU/RoboScope-Kit.
notes: observed_searches[0] ran the autotune code of main on d26a908; observed_searches[1] ran #81 on 81e3824. Both probed the same seven K/g and stopped on predicted GPU memory at K=20/g=5, so this workload does not separate them. Each probe names its search, and is the first repeat of its K/g in search 0 and the second in search 1.
Fixed runs are full 500-episode evaluations of libero_10 on d26a908 (Kit 0.8.0b27), on one host with 20 CPU cores by cgroup. Every run completed 500 of 500 episodes, with 444 to 453 successes.

Fixed runs at 16/4 and 12/4 ran three times each, interleaved with others, within about 2.5 hours of one night. These repeats hold no drift between days; on RoboCasa that drift reached 13%, so their spread of 0.69% is not the drift a user sees.
16/4 and 12/4 are tied: their medians differ by 0.1%, inside their spreads of 0.17% and 0.21%. The 12/4 is listed as best only because its median is higher.

All probes are diagonal probes. Default two-phase runs a fixed-size probe, which this record does not cover, and it runs off the record at K=9/g=2 (K=8/g=5 with the steady estimator), so its score here only shows how it would decide on these rates.
evaluation_steps is the 136783 steps of the full evaluation after the main search. Episodes stop on success, so full evaluations here took 134955 to 138232 steps.

observed_searches.stop_reason: worker gain 4.5% at K=8 below knee 25.0%; K=20, g=5 predicted GPU memory 54.5 GiB on the busiest GPU above 46.0 GiB
worker gain 6.3% at K=8 below knee 25.0%; K=20, g=5 predicted GPU memory 54.7 GiB on the busiest GPU above 46.0 GiB

unmeasured: Every K/g that no search probed and no fixed run covered.
